verdict.rationale: Signifyd's ReadMe-hosted docs serve per-page Markdown mirrors that an agent can read. A probe confirmed the .md version of the reference introduction returns HTTP 200, and an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec is published. However, the probe of developer.signifyd.com/llms.txt returned 404, which contradicts the claim that llms.txt is served, so agents get no index file. missing for 10: a working llms.txt index (probe returned 404), any agent-specific docs guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Signifyd publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document
